target_segments: Grade 3 peripheral neuropathy or Grade 3 ototoxicity, each persisting for more than 6 weeks after the last dose.

text_span: each persisting for more than 6 weeks after the last dose
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: peripheral neuropathy and ototoxicity are distinct screening targets. The phrase 'each persisting' explicitly applies the grade-duration requirement to both alternatives (X2).

text_span: Grade 3 ototoxicity, each persisting for more than 6 weeks after the last dose.
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: ototoxicity is independently evaluable from peripheral neuropathy and carries the shared grade-duration requirement.
